scope.admission: Read-only provenance for the exact options created by the default official summarizer, bound to its actual agent and session
scope.default: No authorization is granted; ordinary Free summarization and all native summary selection, persistence and retry behavior are retained
scope.boundary: Publish immediately before the concrete stream; delete in finally. Immutable static lookup reads only this fixed official module, including isolated engines; custom engine lookups cannot synthesize provenance
limitations: Consumers must still bind current accepted input roots, turn, owner and revocation generation
purpose and sessionId strings alone never publish provenance
Custom summarizer overrides do not publish default-summary provenance
